import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_oneway

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(data_file_path: str):
    df = pd.read_csv(data_file_path)

    numeric_df = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    for col in df.columns:
        converted = pd.to_numeric(
            df[col].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(",", ".", regex=False),
            errors="coerce",
        )
        numeric_df[col] = converted

    means = numeric_df.mean()
    std_devs = numeric_df.std()

    axes = []
    for col in numeric_df.columns:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        values = numeric_df[col].dropna().to_numpy()
        ax.hist(values, bins="auto")
        ax.set_title(col)
        ax.set_xlabel(col)
        ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
        axes.append(ax)

    anova_rows = []
    valid_cols = [col for col in numeric_df.columns if numeric_df[col].dropna().shape[0] >= 2]

    if len(valid_cols) >= 2:
        for i in range(len(valid_cols)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(valid_cols)):
                col1 = valid_cols[i]
                col2 = valid_cols[j]
                sample1 = numeric_df[col1].dropna().to_numpy()
                sample2 = numeric_df[col2].dropna().to_numpy()

                try:
                    f_value, p_value = f_oneway(sample1, sample2)
                    f_value = float(f_value)
                    p_value = float(p_value)
                except Exception:
                    f_value = float("nan")
                    p_value = float("nan")

                anova_rows.append(
                    {
                        "Column 1": col1,
                        "Column 2": col2,
                        "F-value": f_value,
                        "P-value": p_value,
                    }
                )

    anova_results = pd.DataFrame(anova_rows, columns=["Column 1", "Column 2", "F-value", "P-value"])

    return means, std_devs, axes, anova_results
